description: Source code for the class QrSegmentAdvanced, implementing advanced QR code segmentation logic including optimal segment splitting, mode switching, and Kanji encoding support.

classes.name: QrSegmentAdvanced
classes.description: Provides static methods for advanced QR code segmentation, including optimal mode segmentation and Kanji encoding.

methods.name: makeSegmentsOptimally
methods.description: Creates an optimal list of QR segments for a given Unicode string within specified version constraints, minimizing total bit length.

methods.name: makeSegmentsOptimally (private)
methods.description: Internal method to compute the optimal segments for a specific version.

methods.name: computeBitCosts
methods.description: Calculates the cost in bits for encoding segments of data in different modes, using dynamic programming.

methods.name: computeCharacterModes
methods.description: Determines the optimal mode for each character by working backwards from the end, based on bit costs.

methods.name: splitIntoSegments
methods.description: Splits data into segments based on computed character modes, grouping consecutive characters in the same mode.

methods.name: isAlphanumeric
methods.description: Checks if a character is valid in alphanumeric mode.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a character is a digit.

methods.name: makeKanjiSegment
methods.description: Encodes a string as a Kanji mode segment, throwing if characters are not encodable.

methods.name: isEncodableAsKanji
methods.description: Tests whether a string can be encoded entirely in Kanji mode.
